user.title: Connect to homepool
user.description: Enter your homepool server URL and API key (from Settings → API Key in the homepool web app), e.g. https://your-domain/api. If you leave out the scheme (http:// or https://) or the /api path, we'll try adding them automatically.

error.timeout: Timed out waiting for a response from the homepool server
error.cannot_resolve_host: Could not resolve the homepool server's hostname — check the URL
error.connection_refused: Connection refused by the homepool server — check the URL and port
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the homepool server
error.no_installations: This account has no pools or spas set up yet

abort.already_configured: This homepool account is already configured

init.title: Custom sensors
init.description: Choose the pool or spa you want to configure.

sensors.title: Custom sensors
sensors.description: Use one of your own Home Assistant entities for any reading of {installation} — a smart probe, a template sensor, a helper — instead of the value homepool recorded. Leave a reading empty to keep using homepool's own value. If the chosen entity is unavailable, non-numeric or reports a unit that can't be converted, homepool's value is used instead.

data.push_back: Write these readings back to homepool

data_description.push_back: Records the readings above as real homepool measurements, so they appear in the web app's history and feed its dosing advice. A measurement is only logged when at least one reading has changed.
data_description.push_interval_minutes: How often the readings are checked and, if they changed, logged to homepool. Higher values mean fewer history entries.

abort.no_installations: No pools or spas are available yet — make sure the integration is connected to your homepool server, then try again
